Subject: Debrief: Senior Inference Engineer — Sam Choe (onsite)

Team — thanks again for taking the time this morning to interview Sam (onsite loop). Quick ask so we can land a recommendation by EOD: please send a one-paragraph summary + the numeric scorecard below for your interview segment. If you see material red flags, call it out explicitly.

Scorecard (1-5):
- Systems (distributed systems, infra)
- Model understanding (attention, KV cache, latency tradeoffs)
- Problem solving (debugging, design)
- Culture/team fit
- Recommendation (Strong Yes / Yes / Neutral / No)

Use the rubric linked here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-debrief-rubric (short notes suffice). I attached the rubric to this thread as well. I’ll consolidate and propose next step.

Thanks — Karthik

Karthik — thanks. My read: technically excellent, strong systems intuition, but needs polish on communication when explaining tradeoffs under uncertainty. Spends time building the right mental model before proposing tradeoffs, which I liked.

Scorecard (Marissa):
- Systems: 5
- Model understanding: 4
- Problem solving: 5
- Culture/team fit: 4
- Recommendation: Yes (hire)

Notes:
- Liked the end-to-end tracing question — designed a KV-cache-aware sharding approach that accounted for tail latency.
- Follow-ups: ask about prior work with mixed-precision quantized models — sample responses were high-level; would want a short tech test if we proceed.

Attaching my scorecard: sam_choe_scorecard_marissa.pdf

--
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference

On one behavioral scenario (working across infra and product), Sam defaulted to ‘I would own that’ rather than aligning escalation and handoff points. Could be framing, or could be a preference for ownership that complicates cross-team workflows.

Scorecard (Diego):

- Model understanding: 4
- Problem solving: 4
- Culture/team fit: 3
- Recommendation: Neutral (lean Yes with reference check)

Notes:
- Technical depth is there; would like a short reference check focused on cross-team delivery and communication.
- No safety/security red flags.

Thanks all — consolidated below. I did the math and put the averages in parentheses. Please read and flag if I mis-entered anything.

Consolidated scores (avg):
- Systems: (4.5)
- Model understanding: (4.25)
- Problem solving: (4.5)
- Culture/team fit: (3.75)

Summary: strong technical candidate with solid systems and model instincts. Primary concern is cross-team collaboration style (Diego/Marissa flagged different aspects of communication around handoffs). Consensus is to proceed but close the loop on collaboration signals.

Proposed next steps:
1) Phone reference check focused on cross-team delivery (Ava can schedule two references; ask these specific prompts).
2) A short sync (30m) with Principal Engineer on cross-team scenarios if references are mixed.
3) If references check out, move to offer (level: Senior/IC5).

Ava — can you please schedule the references and block a 30m slot with Marcus (principal) if we need it? Recruiter copied. I’ll hold off on any offer paperwork until we confirm references.

If anyone objects to that path, call it out now — otherwise I’ll mark this as a hire-conditional-on-references and move forward.

Thanks — Karthik
